text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mars rover to visit nearby rock: Sojourner overcomes communication problem and trundles out to look at Barnacle Bill.
- Orange march ignites violence: Northern Ireland rocked by rioting.
- Mexico City swings to left: Mayor's election a blow to PRI.
- Woman suing police finds past spotlighted: 'Damaged-goods theory' means private records fair game, rape victim says.
- Interlink Freight to shut down: Union says employee-owned trucker in receivership; closing to cost more than 2,000 jobs.
- Edper seeks the simple life: The group is winning converts with moves such as its proposed merger with Brascan.
- Japanese cars getting cheaper: While Big 3 raise prices, Japan-based car makers take cost cuts to consumer.
- Experts grow more gloomy on outlook for bullion, bonds.
- Bre-X suit targets brokers' Net advice: Nesbitt and Levesque blamed for losses by non-client investors.
- Golds retreat further on bullion's freefall.
- Gerry Pencer: Man with a mission.
